name: ContractHero
description:
ContractHero is a contract management platform. This connector lets Claude read
your ContractHero repository so you can ask questions about your contracts in
plain language instead of clicking through them.

Who it's for: legal, operations, procurement and finance teams who keep their
contracts in ContractHero.
What you can ask:
• Which contracts expire in the next quarter, and what are their notice periods
• Find the contracts with a particular counterparty, category or custom field value
• Summarise a specific contract, or pull a clause out of its text
• See which documents belong to a contract, and read a specific one
• What is open on my contract tasks
• Which categories, custom fields and contact types does my organisation use

The connector is read-only. It can list, search and read contracts, contract text,
documents, categories, custom fields, contacts and tasks. It cannot create, change,
delete or send anything, and it cannot sign contracts. Every request is scoped to the
permissions your ContractHero user already has. The connector never widens access.

Requirements: an existing ContractHero account on a plan that includes the MCP
connector, and the connector enabled for your organisation. 
Accounts are provided by ContractHero to customer organisations; to arrange access, contact ContractHero at contracthero.com.

The connector itself is free, but it requires an active, paid ContractHero subscription; there is no separate in-app purchase

_published_faq.name: How do I add ContractHero to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ContractHero to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.contracthero.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ContractHero MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ContractHero lists 13 MCP tools, including get_contact, get_contract, get_contract_text, get_document, list_categories, list_contact_field_definitions, list_contact_types, list_contacts, list_contracts, list_custom_field_definitions, list_documents, and list_tasks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ContractHero?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ContractHero in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
ContractHero requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ContractHero is developed by ContractHero GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
